limitations: Separate algorithm versions and cohorts, not pooled independent trials.
Two seeds per main comparison; no statistical superiority or safety probability claim.
V3 predeclared repeat had negative body-proxy clearance and is retained.
Corrected policy still failed one main deceleration endpoint and an overtaking transfer endpoint.
Preview validity is not a closed-loop safety guarantee; original unvalidated zero-command failure branch remains a limitation.
Long mean forecasts use held last-window axes and are soft decision approximations.
No new multi-robot or hardware validation, no new solver or new input bounds.

Development V2 omitted a dynamic input flag required by its old hypothesis screen, so that prototype decision replay is not complete; failure retained. All 34 frozen trials passed their version-correct audits.
